records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Sam,

Welcome aboard! Wrenfield is built for teams, so it gets more useful once at least one other person is in it -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Happy to help if you hit a wall.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: 6 days in with no project, no invite, no key milestone, and zero replies to two outreach emails (email:f1ee99ff, email:84d4cceb); no tickets at all. Team plan and active subscription suggest real intent, but total silence plus no setup progress makes unaided activation in 8 days unlikely.

draft.subject: A hand with your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Sam,

Following up on my note last week — I know setup time is hard to find. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, so getting that first project up is usually the quickest way to see whether it fits how Ridge Studio works. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week work? I'm glad to walk through that first project with you live and answer anything as we go.

Best,
Priya
